lastCommit.message:
[ota-hal] OTA-1696: the fight sheds its passengers

The second bundle the owner pushed at 13:32 (#mtof9i1d5eoj, stamp 1690) is
his hang on paper. A five-raider fight, 13:28–13:31: seven freeze-watch
stalls in three minutes, each right after a DODGE / APPROACH / attack, the
JS thread 2.5–5.2s late while frames kept coming, the engine's own log
lines 70–150ms apart where they are normally 1ms, and the MiniLM classifier
reading 0.4–7.4s per action (one-enemy actions included: 5.5s median)
against its usual 0.35s. `native: cognition running` on four of the seven
stall lines; Qwen idle throughout; TTS off; no memory warning; no input
lock anywhere in the code. The night session on the same build and phone
read 1.5s dodge-to-next-tap and one stall in five hours.

Two loads ride every combat tap. The classifier: onnxruntime's default
intra-op pool is one thread per core — eight on the Tensor G5 — spinning
for the run, for a mood tag the parser did not need on a chip it resolved
at conf=1.00. The feed: `gameLog` is an external-store subscription, so
every appendLog commits synchronously, and AdventureFeed re-mapped EVERY
visible entry — up to five hundred rich rows — on each of the twenty-five
lines a five-raider round writes.

Four levers:
  - COGNITION_SESSION_OPTIONS: intraOpNumThreads 2 / interOpNumThreads 1
    on both classifier session creates (the JSI binding parses it —
    onnxruntime-react-native/cpp/SessionUtils.cpp).
  - cognitionGate.cognitionSkippedInCombat: no classifier pass on a
    confident action (conf ≥ 0.9) with hostiles on the field; free text in
    a fight and everything outside one are untouched; the OTA-1359 stamps
    keep their order inside the condition.
  - AdventureFeed keeps FEED_WINDOW (150) rows mounted; each row is a
    memoised FeedRow; the enemy-name list is keyed on its contents so the
    screen's fresh array per render no longer invalidates every row. The
    trailing chips stay outside the map (OTA-1457, pin re-anchored).
Two clocks:
  - renderClock.renderLagAfterEngine: the exploration screen reads the
    live crumb before its `rendered` heartbeat stamps over it and prints
    `render⏱ Nms after engine-done · feed N` once per action past 300ms.
  - The stall line grows ` · heap NMB · gc +Nms/K · feed N`
    (HermesInternal.getInstrumentedStats, delta per sample), so a collector
    pause can no longer hide behind "something blocked the JS thread".

Suite: __tests__/ota1696TheFightShedsItsPassengers.test.ts (7).
